response.sql: WITH cc AS (SELECT pc.college_id, c.state AS state, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.player_id) AS cnt FROM player_college pc JOIN college c ON c.college_id = pc.college_id GROUP BY pc.college_id, c.state), tot AS (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_cnt, SUM(cnt) * 1.0 AS total_cnt FROM cc) SELECT CASE WHEN cc.state IS NULL OR TRIM(cc.state) = '' THEN '' ELSE cc.state END AS state, AVG(cc.cnt * 1.0) AS avg_player_count, AVG(cc.cnt / tot.avg_cnt) AS avg_relative_to_mean, AVG(cc.cnt / tot.total_cnt) AS avg_share_of_total FROM cc CROSS JOIN tot GROUP BY CASE WHEN cc.state IS NULL OR TRIM(cc.state) = '' THEN '' ELSE cc.state END
